policy: Separate post-merge integration controls; original matched ABBA receipts remain bound to753884b8. Pinned old corpus bytes retain the same input vectors. All new requests retained; no new sustained-decode comparison.

cadence.policy: Fixed rest before each group; subsequent requests retain the ordinary 0.6s host-screen interval. Optional quiet admission precedes each rest. No selective removal or promotion. Same loaded worker, input and seed; MTP route fixed within each cycle.

execution_profile.configuration_flags_semantics: Known selector environment values, including inactive selectors; not dispatch proof.
execution_profile.recipe_wrapper_binding: Source hash only; invocation is not observed.

host_attribution_sampler.process_cpu_source: ps cumulative process CPU time; host resolution dependent
host_attribution_sampler.gpu_client_identity: IORegistryEntryID when available; per-PID aggregate fallback otherwise
host_attribution_sampler.gpu_pid_aggregate_ambiguity_note: Missing entry IDs can hide client changes within a PID.
host_attribution_sampler.gpu_device_utilization_note: Reported utilization does not measure GPU clocks or residency.
